title: Evergreen discovery
body:
Aisha Bello: Month-end close takes us 11 days; we need it under 5 by the next audit.
Aisha Bello: Budget sits with Marcus, our CFO; I can get you thirty minutes with him next week.
Aisha Bello: We will probably compare a couple of options first.
Aisha Bello: Every month the finance team loses a week reconciling spreadsheets by hand and the auditors keep flagging it.
Aisha Bello: I think this could work for us.
Aisha Bello: We have looked at a couple of other tools.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Aisha Bello: Sounds good.
summary: Discovery: metric, pain and budget holder named in the first meeting.

title: Evergreen solution workshop
body:
Aisha Bello: Our CFO signed off the target: close in 5 days by Q4, which she values at about 200k a year in audit and overtime.
Aisha Bello: Budget sits with Marcus, our CFO; I can get you thirty minutes with him next week.
Aisha Bello: The must-haves are audit trail, SSO and a two-week rollout.
Aisha Bello: Security review first, then a steering committee vote in July, then procurement.
Aisha Bello: If we miss the audit deadline again we lose the clean opinion, and that is a covenant issue with the bank.
Aisha Bello: I have already told my director we should do this and I can set up the meeting.
Aisha Bello: We are also talking to LedgerPro and the incumbent spreadsheet process is the real alternative.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Aisha Bello: Sounds good.
